name: FDA Press Announcements
note: Official FDA news releases (approvals, clearances, safety actions). Verified HTTP 200 + parseable RSS from this environment on 2026-07-12. NOTE: a prior step reported fda.gov blocking non-browser curl agents; the RSS endpoints and press-announcement pages DID resolve (200) here, so it is enabled. A browser-like User-Agent is sent at runtime as a safety margin.

name: CDC Online Newsroom
note: CDC's official newsroom feed served via the curl-friendly tools.cdc.gov content API (www.cdc.gov itself is JS-rendered). Verified HTTP 200 + parseable RSS. High-volume; the fetcher only takes the freshest new items.

name: FDA MedWatch Safety Alerts
note: FDA MedWatch recalls and safety communications. Verified HTTP 200 + parseable RSS from this environment on 2026-07-12.

name: arXiv — AI in Healthcare (preprints)
note: arXiv API (Atom) query for the newest AI-in-healthcare preprints. A primary source for research signals — but preprints are NOT peer-reviewed, so briefs flag this and require independent verification before publication. Verified HTTP 200 + parseable Atom on 2026-07-12.

name: NIH News Releases
note: NIH News Releases. Kept in config but DISABLED: www.nih.gov is behind Cloudflare and returns HTTP 403 ('Just a moment...') to non-browser agents (curl AND native fetch) from this environment. The fetcher skips blocked_from_env feeds gracefully. Re-enable if the environment gains a browser-capable fetch path.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov — recently posted studies
note: ClinicalTrials.gov new-study RSS. Verified reachable (HTTP 200 + parseable RSS), but DISABLED by default: the unfiltered new-studies feed is very high-volume and noisy for an editorial signal. Enable only when scoped to a specific condition/term for a targeted brief.

name: medRxiv Preprints
note: Verified HTTP 200 + parseable RSS/Atom from this environment on 2026-09-21.
